task.title: Running the Red Hat Quay Operator in debug mode
task.shortdesc: To run the Red Hat Quay Operator in debug mode and get verbose logging for troubleshooting, you can edit the QuayRegistry custom resource and add DEBUGLOG=true to the env overrides. After the Operator restarts, try pulling an image or dump logs from Quay pods for more information.

step.cmd: Enter the following command to edit the QuayRegistry custom resource definition:
Update the QuayRegistry to add the following parameters:

info.codeblock: spec: - kind: quay managed: true overrides: env: - name: DEBUGLOG value: "true"

step.cmd: After the Red Hat Quay Operator has restarted with debugging enabled, try pulling an image from the registry. If the pull is still slow, dump all logs from all Quay pods to a file, and check the files for more information.
